Bamboo Bistro offers a modern yet cozy atmosphere, perfect for both working and relaxing. Just steps away from Trần Hưng Đạo Temple, it’s a quiet spot with soothing music and friendly staff. The menu features a great mix of flavorful vegetarian dishes—not bland at all—and drinks that range from healthy blends to classic choices.
Whether you're in the mood for a calm workspace or a casual meetup with friends, this spot has it all. Ideal for a post-temple visit or anytime you want a wholesome, feel-good meal.
Read more
Insider tip:
Quiet, cozy spot near Trần Hưng Đạo Temple. Must-try: flavorful veggie dishes & detox drinks. Best time? Morning or late afternoon chill

This vegetarian restaurant has a clean, quiet, and comfortable space. The menu is diverse with many delicious vegetarian dishes and a variety of drinks, especially the herbal pho, which has a unique, rich, and appealing flavor. The food is freshly prepared and beautifully presented. The staff are friendly and serve quickly. Prices are reasonable and suitable for many customers. It’s an excellent choice for anyone who wants to enjoy light and healthy vegetarian cuisine.
